notes.title: A Brand New Version
notes.notes:
Hey!everyone. This is a brand new version,many systems have been remake.
More aircraft types and cannon types,the levels have also been redesigned.
Each level you can obtain up to 5 stars.After earning a certain number of stars, you can unlock the new type of cannons.New cannons often come with interesting weapons.With these you can win the game more easily.
